headline: Nigerian Stock Exchange Market Capitalization Falls ₦2.99 Trillion on Stock Decline
summary: The Nigerian Exchange All-Share Index dropped 1.83% to 247,660.74 points during the week, erasing ₦2.99 trillion in market value. The contraction was driven by share price declines in cement, banking, and energy stocks.
why: The Nigerian Exchange is the equity capital platform for West Africa's largest economy, heavily weighted by industrial conglomerates and banks.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: The index lost 1.83% of its value as major industrial and energy stocks declined.
